item.title: Rock Bridge football defeats Jefferson City after a strong first half

item.title: Tigers withstand penalties, beat Kansas by 17 in Lawrence
item.description:
LAWRENCE, Kan. (KMIZ) It wasn’t the prettiest game in the world, but the Tigers got it done on the road against their rival.
